claims.summary: Bazaar of Baghdad proved that drawing and discarding could be more valuable than producing mana, especially once the graveyard became an engine rather than a destination.
The Japanese official August 19, 2018 Survival registration contains Bazaar, Rootwalla, Squee, Vengevine and Hollow One.
Madness waits for the activation to finish; Rootwalla and Hollow One can be the first and second creature spells, returning haste Vengevine. Alternative-cost spells still receive applicable taxes.
Bazaar is unrestricted in Vintage and banned in Legacy on the official list checked October 16, 2026.
